title: stems workspace configuration
description: Root of a `stems.yaml` file (or an included / local file).

name.description: Workspace name (defaults to the integration repo's directory name).

env.description: Environment applied to every stem (stem `env` wins).

requires.description:
Tool version requirements, e.g. `node: ">=20"`, or
`mytool: { version: ">=1.2", command: "mytool -V", regex: "v([0-9.]+)" }`.

checks.description:
User-defined checks run by `stems doctor` and before `stems up`
(workspace root as the working directory).

default_profile.description: Profile used by `up` when none is given.

strict_profiles.description: Refuse to start stems outside the selected profile, even as dependencies.

profile.description:
Profile `up` uses when none is given (`--profile` / `STEMS_PROFILE`);
meant for `stems.local.yaml`, wins over `default_profile`.

agent.description: Guard rails for the agent / MCP interface.

config.description: How the daemon handles config changes (`config.reload`, 33).

notifications.description: Desktop notifications when stems fail for good (34).

secrets.description:
Env names whose values are secret (47): redacted in `stems show`,
`stems env`, `status -v`, the MCP server and `logs --export`, and
scrubbed from log lines. Adds to the built-in name patterns; an entry
prefixed `!` (`"!PUBLIC_KEY"`) is an exception that is never redacted.

redaction.description: Adjust the built-in secret name patterns (47).

include.description: Extra YAML files merged into this one (paths relative to this file).

extends.description: A base workspace file merged underneath this one.

configurations.description:
Named configurations: overlays with the shape of `stems.local.yaml`,
inline or as a path (relative to this file) to a YAML file. The
selected one is merged between this file and `stems.local.yaml`.

default_configuration.description: Configuration used when `configuration:` does not select one.

configuration.description:
The selected configuration (`none` for no configuration); meant for
`stems.local.yaml`, wins over `default_configuration`.

Scalar.description: A YAML scalar that is used as a string (env values, vars, arg defaults).

Requirement.description:
A `requires:` entry: a version range for a known tool (`node: ">=20"`), or
a range plus the command that prints the version and an optional regex
whose first capture group (else whole match) is the version.

RequirementSpec.description:
Long form of a [`Requirement`]. Exactly one of `version` and `from` is
set (checked by `validate`).

from.description:
Read the range from a file of the codebase (the workspace root for a
workspace-level entry): `.nvmrc`, `.tool-versions`,
`package.json#packageManager`, `go.mod`, `file.toml#a.b`. A list uses
the first file that exists.

command.description: Shell command printing the version; default `<tool> --version`.

regex.description:
Regex extracting the version from the command output (first capture
group, else the whole match); default: the first `N[.N[.N]]` number.

StringOrList.description: A command given either as one shell string or as an argv list.

RawCheck.description: A user-defined check (`checks.<name>`): a shell command, exit 0 = ok.

command.description: Shell command; exit 0 means the check passes.

message.description: Shown when the check fails (default: `check failed`).

hint.description: What to do about a failure.

timeout.description: Kill the command after this long (default `2s`, max `30s`).

fix.description: Shell command `stems doctor --fix` runs to repair a failure.

when.description:
Where it runs: any of `doctor`, `up`, `validate` (default
`[doctor, up]`).

CheckSeverity.description: How a failing custom check counts (`checks.<name>.severity`).

oneOf.description: A failure: `doctor` exits 1 and `stems up` aborts (default).

Profile.description: A profile: a list of stems, or the name of another profile.

allowed_tools.description: If non-empty, only these MCP tools are exposed.

max_size.description: Rotate a stem's log file at this size.

ring.description: Lines kept per stem in the daemon's in-memory ring buffer.

ByteSize.description: A size in bytes, or with a unit: `512KB`, `10MB`, `2GB` (1KB = 1024 bytes).

reload.description:
What the daemon does when `stems.yaml`, `stems.local.yaml` or an
included file changes while it runs.

auto_apply.description:
Apply changes on their own: `false` (wait for `stems config apply`),
`true` (what needs no restart) or `all` (everything).

AutoApply.description: `false`: wait for `stems config apply`; `true`: apply what needs no restart; `all`: apply everything, restarts included.

Notifications.description:
`notifications:` block (34): one desktop notification when stems end up
`failed` and nothing will retry them.

enabled.description:
Post desktop notifications (default `true`). The environment
`STEMS_NOTIFICATIONS=0|off|false` on the daemon wins over the file.

debounce.description:
Quiet time after a failure before the notification is posted, so
failures that come together are one notification (default `2s`).

cooldown.description:
After a notification, failures inside this window are held and
posted together when it ends (default `30s`).

command.description:
A command to run instead of the OS notifier (`/bin/sh -c`), with
`STEMS_NOTIFY_TITLE`, `STEMS_NOTIFY_BODY`, `STEMS_NOTIFY_STEMS`,
`STEMS_NOTIFY_WORKSPACE` in its environment and the JSON payload on
stdin. `null` (default): `terminal-notifier` / `osascript` (macOS) or
`notify-send` (Linux), whichever is on `PATH`.

Redaction.description: `redaction:` block (47): which env names count as secret.

Script.description: A script: an inline shell string or a full spec.

ScriptSpec.description: Full script form. Exactly one of `command` / `file` is expected.

file.description: Script file in the integration repo (relative to the workspace root).

description.description: Shown in the TUI and as the MCP tool description.

inputs.description: Stamp inputs: globs relative to the codebase.

requires.description: Stems that must be healthy before this script runs.

requires_stopped.description:
Stems that must be stopped (or failed) before this script runs
(`stems run --stop-deps` stops them first).

timeout.description: Kill the script after this long.

soft_fail.description:
A failure (after retries) does not fail the stem or `up`: the stem
is degraded, nothing is stamped, the script runs again next time.
Only for `setup`, `seed`, `pre_start`, `post_start`, `build` and
workspace `bootstrap`.

when.description:
`build` only: `on_demand` (default: `stems build`, `restart --build`,
watch `rebuild`), `changed` (also in the start sequence after
`setup`, when its stamp is missing or changed) or `always` (on every
start).

concurrent.description: May run concurrently with other scripts of the same stem.

stamp_env.description: Env var names whose values are part of the stamp hash.

inherit_env.description:
Inherit the environment of the `stems` command (default true).
`false`: only `PATH HOME USER LOGNAME SHELL TMPDIR TERM LANG LC_*`
of it, plus everything stems sets (`PORT`, `env`, `env_files`,
`STEMS_*`): a reproducible `setup`/`build`.

ArgType.description: Declared type of a script argument.

oneOf.description:
In the start sequence (after `setup`, before `pre_start`) when its
stamp is missing or changed.
In the start sequence on every start (never on a policy respawn).

Configuration.description:
One entry of `configurations:`: an inline overlay (the shape of
`stems.local.yaml`) or the path of a YAML file holding one.

anyOf.description: Path of a YAML overlay file, relative to the file naming it.

Stem.description:
One stem. Type-specific fields are listed flat; using a field that does
not apply to the stem's `type` is reported as a diagnostic.

name.description: Must equal the map key if given.

type.description: `process`, `docker`, `compose` or `external`. Required once all files are merged.

codebase.description: Local path or git repository with the stem's code.

enabled.description:
`false` keeps the stem listed but excludes it from runs. A bool, or a
string rendered by substitution (46): `true|1|yes|on` /
`false|0|no|off|""` (case-insensitive), e.g. `"${env.WITH_SEARCH}"`
(an unset variable counts as false here).

env_files.description:
Env files (relative to the workspace root), applied after `env`
(their values win): a path, or `{path, required: false}` for a file
that may be absent.

depends_on.description: Dependencies: a stem name or `{stem, condition, soft, protocol, via}`.

outputs.description:
Values published for dependants (FR-ST-6), evaluated when the stem
becomes healthy: a template string, or `{command, secret}`.

overlays.description: Files materialised into the codebase at run time.

secrets.description:
Env names of this stem whose values are secret (47), on top of the
workspace's `secrets` and the built-in patterns; `!NAME` is an
exception (never redacted). See the workspace `secrets`.

requires.description:
Tool version requirements checked for this stem (when enabled), with
its codebase as the directory for `from:` lookups.

checks.description: User-defined checks of this stem (while enabled), run in its codebase.

variant.description:
Active variant (FR-ST-8): the name of one of `variants`, or `local`
(the base definition, same as leaving it unset). Usually set in
`stems.local.yaml`, e.g. by `stems switch <stem> <variant>`.

variants.description:
Named alternative definitions of this stem (FR-ST-8): partial stem
definitions deep-merged over the base when active (`variant:`). A
variant that changes `type` drops the base's type-specific fields.

inherit.description:
(variants only) `false`: the variant does not inherit the base
definition; it is merged over an empty stem (only `enabled` and the
selection are kept), so it must be complete, `type` included.

cwd.description: (process) Working directory, relative to the codebase.

command.description: (process, docker) Command to run. Process: a shell string; docker: overrides CMD.

build.description:
(docker) Build instead of pulling: `{ context, dockerfile, secrets,
allow_read }`. (compose) `true` (default) / `false`: run `compose up
--build`; or `{ services, before_setup, secrets, allow_read }` (44).

file.description: (compose) Compose file (relative to the workspace root).

service.description: (compose) Service name (defaults to the stem name).

project_name.description: (compose) Compose project name (defaults to the workspace name).

adopt.description: (compose) Adopt an already-running service instead of starting it.

inject_env.description:
(compose) Also put the stem's env into the service's container
(an `env_file:` override file), not only use it for interpolation.

oneOf.description: A local process (process group) started by stems.
A service of a docker compose project.
Monitored only; never started or stopped.

Codebase.description: `codebase:` — a path string (local path or git URL) or `{git, ref, path}`.

anyOf.description: Local path (absolute, `~/…`, or relative to the integration repo), or a git URL.

Enabled.description:
`stems.<n>.enabled` (46): a bool, or a string (usually a `${…}`
template) read as `true|1|yes|on` / `false|0|no|off|""` once
substituted. Anything else is `SCHEMA_INVALID` at resolve time.

EnvFile.description: One `env_files:` entry: a path, or `{path, required}`.

anyOf.description: Path relative to the workspace root; the file must exist.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

required.description:
`false`: an absent file is skipped (default `true`: absent is
`ENV_FILE_NOT_FOUND`).

port.description: Host port number, or `auto` to allocate a free one at start.

soft.description: Informational only: no ordering, allowed in cycles.

if_disabled.description:
When the target is disabled (hard edges only, 46, 51): `start`
(default) starts this stem without it; `skip` skips this stem on
`up`/`start`.

oneOf.description: The dependency passed its health check.
The dependency is healthy and its `seed` script completed.

Protocol.description: Informational protocol carried by a `depends_on` edge.

IfDisabled.description: What a hard `depends_on` edge does when its target is disabled (46, 51).

oneOf.description:
The dependant is skipped by `up`/`start` (`dependency_disabled:<dep>`),
and so are its own hard dependants.
The dependant starts without it (the default): the edge is dropped.

port.description: (tcp, grpc) Port (default: the stem's first port).

insecure.description: (http) Accept invalid TLS certificates (self-signed dev certs).

cwd.description: (command) Working directory, relative to the stem's codebase.

start_period.description: Failures during this period after start are not counted.

start_timeout.description: Give up on becoming healthy after this long.

oneOf.description: HTTP request returns the expected status (and body).

HealthPort.description: A health port: a number or a substitution string like `${stem.web.port}`.

ignore.description: Extra globs to ignore (added to the built-in ignores).

settle.description: Quiet period after an action before the rule can fire again.

cascade.description:
Cascade a `restart`/`rebuild` to the stem's hard dependants
(default: the stem's `restart.cascade`).

WatchRoot.description: What a watch rule's `paths` are relative to.

max.description: Max restarts within `window` before the stem is marked failed.

on_unhealthy.description: Restart when the health check reports unhealthy.

unhealthy_grace.description: How long a stem may stay unhealthy before `on_unhealthy` restarts it.

cascade.description:
Cascading restarts: when this stem is restarted (by you, a watchdog
or this policy), also restart its running hard dependants,
transitively, in dependency order (default `false`).

oneOf.description: Restart when the stem exits non-zero / crashes.

cpu.description:
CPU threshold: cores (`1.5`) or a percentage of one core, optionally
sustained (`"80% for 60s"`).

MemoryLimit.description: A memory threshold: a size (`2GB`, or bytes as an integer), optionally sustained: `2GB for 30s`.

CpuLimit.description: A CPU threshold: cores as a number (`1.5`), or a percentage of one core (`80%`, `150%`), optionally sustained: `80% for 60s`.

Output.description:
An output (FR-ST-6): a template string (`${stem.self.port}` etc.) or a
command whose trimmed stdout is the value.

command.description:
Shell command run in the stem's environment once it is healthy; its
trimmed stdout is the value.

secret.description: Redact the value everywhere stems shows it (`<redacted>`).

template.description: Template (with `${…}` substitution) in the integration repo.

file.description: Plain file copied verbatim from the integration repo.

PullPolicy.description: When a docker stem's `image` is pulled.

oneOf.description: Pull only when the image is not present locally.
Pull on every start and restart (picks up a moved tag such as `latest`).
Never pull; the image must already be present locally.

Build.description:
`stems.<n>.build`: a bool on a compose stem (rebuild the service's
image on every start), an object on a docker stem (what to build) or on
a compose stem (which services, when, with which secrets: 44). Which
form and which keys a stem type accepts is checked at resolve time
(`SCHEMA_INVALID` at `stems.<n>.build`).

anyOf.description:
(compose) Rebuild on every start (`true`, the default) or never
(`false`).

BuildSpec.description:
Build settings of a docker stem (`context`, `dockerfile`) or a compose
stem (`services`); `before_setup`, `secrets` and `allow_read` apply to
both (44, 51).

context.description:
(docker) Build context (relative to the codebase, else the workspace
root).

dockerfile.description: (docker) Dockerfile, relative to the context; may live outside it.

services.description:
(compose) Services whose images are built (default: the stem's
`service`); list extra one-shot services (e.g. `migrate`) here.

secrets.description:
BuildKit secrets (`RUN --mount=type=secret,id=…`): `{id, file}` or
`{id, env}`. Never a build arg, never in a layer.

allow_read.description:
Exact absolute paths outside the build context the build may read
(Bake's `fs.read` entitlement). No globs, no symlinks. The context,
the Dockerfile's directory and secret files are granted already.

BuildSecret.description: One BuildKit secret: `id` plus exactly one of `file` and `env`.

file.description: A file holding the secret (e.g. a credentials JSON).

env.description: An environment variable holding the secret.
